terms.comment: Medieval Latin: Adomnán’s Life of Columba has Mox, Deō volente, ad Scōtiam profectus (book 1). We have found no ancient instance. The Vulgate says sī Dominus voluerit (below).

evidence: Vulg. Jac. 4.15: prō eō ut dīcātis: sī Dominus voluerit, et vīxerimus, faciēmus hoc aut illud
Vulg. 1 Cor. 4.19: veniam autem cito ad vōs, sī Dominus voluerit
terms.comment: Literally “if the Lord wills”: the biblical way of saying it.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Adomnán, Vita Columbae 1, and the Vulgate (James 4.15, 1 Corinthians 4.19), checked against the Latin Library texts (CLTK mirror) (12 November 2026).
